title: October 2026 - Liberty Street Economics
gist: Index page of NY Fed Liberty Street Economics for October 2026 listing two posts: homeowner's insurance moral hazard (residual risk on households) and geoeconomic risk priced in US stocks via supply chains.

insights.claim: NY Fed researchers find keeping homeowners 'on the hook' via deductibles and coverage limits costs insurers relatively little but leaves households with substantial risk, especially those least able to absorb a large loss.
insights.speaker: NY Fed — Liberty Street Economics
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
insights.so_what: Disaster losses are borne disproportionately by vulnerable households.

insights.claim: NY Fed staff find domestic US stocks expose investors to substantial geoeconomic risk through firms' global supply-chain relationships, and investors are compensated with higher risk premia.
insights.speaker: NY Fed — Liberty Street Economics
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
insights.so_what: Geoeconomic risk is a priced factor; supply-chain exposure matters for portfolio construction.
